responsibility: This file implements reading, writing, and application of Fortran module files and submodule files. It serializes and deserializes symbols, symtrees, interfaces, commons, equivalences, renames, and intrinsic-module entities through gfortran’s gzipped list-like module format; maintains pointer fixups and symbol numbering while loading or saving; and manages pending USE statements, module search/open logic, and restoration of module-use state during parsing and semantic processing.
